task: Upgrade the CodeMie A2A client (adapter, client, card_resolver, remote_agent_connection) and its consumer A2AAssistantHandler to A2A protocol v1.0, rewriting the client tests, with the BedrockAdapter v0.3 design decision open.

key_reasoning.reason: Four client modules (adapter, client, card_resolver, remote_agent_connection) plus the A2AAssistantHandler consumer, the shared types alias block and the card-resolver router path. Mostly renames and shape alignment, so it stays at L rather than XL.

The BedrockAdapter fate (keep v0.3, drop, or dual-mode) is an open design decision. The SSE envelope shape, request-side alias naming (id/sessionId vs taskId/contextId) and push-notification method handling are also unpinned, so design decisions are open with rework risk.

Closest existing pattern is the in-house adapter strategy plus the slice-2 server implementation. It does not cover the Bedrock v0.3 remotes (a live feature; cards fail the new AgentCard validation) or SigV4 raw-body signing. Remote A2A calls are currently broken on this branch and stored old-shape agent_card rows are affected, so a rollback plan is needed.

Roughly 4 client files, assistant_handlers.py, types.py and possibly version.py, plus 3 rewritten test files (~1,390 lines) and new adapter tests. About 9 modified and 1-2 new files across src and tests directories.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: no exact precedent for the Bedrock v0.3 adapter under the v1.0 AgentCard; the SigV4 signing surface is unchanged but must be preserved
Requirements Clarity at L: open design decisions (Bedrock adapter fate, SSE envelope, alias naming)
